sources.document: Clasificacion de cuerpos de agua continentales superficiales
admissible_claims: Cuenca Chaman is official hydrologic unit 137752
official classified courses inside 137752 include Rio Chaman, Rio Seco, Quebrada Perol, Rio Loco de Chaman, Quebrada San Gregorio and Rio San Jose
forbidden_inferences: Chepen is a river or basin
Rio La Morana or Quebrada Avispero are automatically children of Cuenca Chaman without reproducible hydrologic evidence
watercourse classification supplies event outcomes or thresholds

sources.document: GORE La Libertad identifica 13 puntos criticos en quebradas y cauces de rios en la provincia de Chepen
admissible_claims: the 2023 official inspection names Quebrada Avispero and the Chaman, Jequetepeque and La Morana rivers as separate physical sources within Chepen province
forbidden_inferences: the 13 critical points are 13 historical events
the named sources form one hydrologic basin
critical-point intervention fichas are event footprints or hydraulic capacity

sources.document: ANA culmino trabajos de prevencion por El Nino en la provincia de Chepen

forbidden_inferences: 26 km intervention length is event geometry
protected-family or crop-area counts are event outcomes

sources.document: Inspeccion de emergencia al rio Chaman por incremento de caudal

forbidden_inferences: the inspection establishes a transferable overflow threshold
all Chepen components had the same response
inspection sectors are a basin polygon
